question: ‘Kharchi Puja’ is primarily celebrated in which of the following states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tripura.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Kharchi Puja:-**

 
 
• This festival primarily originates from the State of Tripura.
 
• Earlier it was festival of the royal family of Tripura, currently, even the common households celebrate this festival.
 
• It is celebrated over a period of 10 days and takes place in the month of July each year.
 
• The festival is celebrated in the honor of mother earth or mother goddess.
 
• Each year thousands of people make the trek to this temple in Agartala so that they can pay obeisance to the deities. 
 
• The temple committee also organizes cultural programs and fairs for the enjoyment of the masses.
